title: Business sender needs collection of several labelled cartons
snapshot: Orris Fold Studio has four labelled cartons on packing list OF-036, each 40 × 30 × 25 cm and 5 kg, 20 kg in total, ready at dispatch door S1 from 10:00 UTC on 2026-03-10. Fesk Rowan asks for confirmation that one vehicle takes all four, since a partial consignment cannot be released.
recorded_action: Iona Quill emailed the Collection planner, Plover Arc Logistics, asking it to confirm capacity for all four cartons, request collection from 10:00 UTC on 2026-03-10 at door S1, and accept DL-036-A to D as one manifest.

negatives.label: Morning van capacity drops to two

new_event.text: At 09:40 a freight job took most of the 2026-03-10 morning van. The 10:00–12:00 collection now has room for two cartons only. Full capacity for all four is open 2026-03-10, 14:00–16:00, or 2026-03-11, 10:00–12:00. Nothing is booked.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Fesk in the Business portal to choose one of the two full-capacity windows, 2026-03-10 14:00–16:00 or 2026-03-11 10:00–12:00, for all four cartons on one manifest.
negatives.must_not: Do not book two cartons in the morning and two later; a split collection is the partial release Fesk ruled out.
negatives.done_means: Fesk's chosen window is booked with all four cartons on one manifest; capacity and manifest still do not prove collection.

negatives.label: Booking save times out, manifest unknown

new_event.text: System notice. Saving the OF-036 booking failed at 09:35 with a timeout. No booking or manifest number was returned. The collection plan may hold a partial entry.

negatives.expected_action: Email the Collection planner and ask what the collection plan shows for OF-036, including any booking and which cartons sit on any manifest, stating that no second booking will be requested until that is known.
negatives.must_not: Do not resend the booking request; a second entry can produce two vehicles or a manifest that splits A to D.
negatives.done_means: The planner confirms one booking with all four cartons on one manifest, or none and one resubmission confirmed once; this still does not prove pickup.

negatives.label: Van arrives with room for two

new_event.text: At door S1 for COL-036. My van has shelf space for two of the four cartons. Studio staff say they cannot release a part load. Do I take two now or leave all four?

negatives.expected_action: Tell the driver in Dispatch chat to take no cartons, and ask the Collection planner by email to provide the capacity reserved under COL-036 for all four cartons within 10:00–12:00, or report that it cannot.
negatives.must_not: Do not let the driver take two cartons now; MN-036 lists all four and Fesk cannot release a partial consignment.
negatives.done_means: The planner confirms a vehicle for all four cartons or states it cannot meet the window; this is not a collection, and any new window needs Fesk's agreement.

negatives.label: Studio reception changes door and cartons

new_event.text: Please move tomorrow's collection to door S4 at 15:00 and add a fifth carton, DL-036-E, 7 kg. Fesk is out today, so just confirm the change with us.

negatives.expected_action: Ask Fesk in the Business portal whether the change comes from Fesk, and send nothing to the Collection planner until Fesk confirms there.
negatives.must_not: Do not forward the door, time or carton change to the planner, and do not share booking details with the reception address.
negatives.done_means: Fesk confirms or rejects the change in the Business portal; until then COL-036 and MN-036 stand as booked, and nothing is collected.

negatives.label: Final weigh differs from the manifest

new_event.from: Fesk Rowan, Orris Fold Studio shipping coordinator
new_event.text: Final weigh before sealing: cartons A, B and C are 5 kg each, carton D is 8 kg. Total 23 kg, not the 20 kg on our packing list. Dimensions are unchanged.

negatives.expected_action: Email the Collection planner with both weights, MN-036 at 20 kg and Fesk's final weigh of 23 kg with carton D at 8 kg, and ask whether the manifest and reserved capacity are amended for 23 kg.
negatives.must_not: Do not tell Fesk the booking covers 23 kg, and do not edit the weight in the desk's own records.
negatives.done_means: The planner states the manifest weight on record and whether capacity covers 23 kg; neither figure is overwritten by the desk, and pickup is still pending.

negatives.label: Studio self-booked before the desk

new_event.text: OF-036 already has a self-service booking made from the studio's business account at 08:50: 2026-03-10, 13:00–15:00, four cartons. Your request would add a second vehicle for the same consignment.

negatives.expected_action: Reply to the Collection planner to link the desk's request to the 08:50 self-service booking and create no second booking, then ask Fesk in the Business portal which single window stands.
negatives.must_not: Do not keep both bookings; two vehicles for one consignment risk the cartons leaving in two parts.
negatives.done_means: One booking remains for all four cartons in the window Fesk confirms; the duplicate is closed, and collection is still pending.
